label: copy-phase input 3 (long sequences, first copy step / last step)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost always (92% of mass) when the fed-back input is the digit 3; weak residual on input p. Never fires in the original or delimiter phase, even when 3 is input there. Concentrated in long sequences (L=9 holds 71% of mass, L=8 22%) and at two positions: step L+1 (input 3 = first original token, 68% of mass) and the final step (16%). Even within these conditions it fires on only a minority of cases (precision ~0.11), so a further unidentified context dependence (partly the token being output) gates it; magnitudes are tiny (max 0.038). Simple in_tok==3 in copy phase has mass recall 0.92 but precision 0.02.
